page_title: WHU 1-2 AST | West Ham v Aston Villa 17/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Tony Harrington is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+7' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
90+6' Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
90+5' The total number of attempts is 11:15.
90+3' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90+3' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Yellow card. Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
89' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
88' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

87' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Emiliano Martinez, who pulls off a comfortable save!
85' Substitution. Vladimir Coufal walks off the pitch and Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) comes on as a substitute.
85' Julen Lopetegui prepares a substitution. Guido Rodriguez is replaced by Danny Ings (West Ham).
84' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Aston Villa was in an offside position.
82' The game has come to an end for Matty Cash. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Kosta Nedeljkovic (Aston Villa).
79' 1 - 2 Goal Jhon Duran (Aston Villa)! Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) was put through by Jacob Ramsey and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 1:2.
76' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
76' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.
74' Here's the change. Leon Bailey leaves the pitch and Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) comes on as a substitute.
74' Substitution. Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lucas Digne walks off.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) for Lucas Paqueta.
73' Here is a change. Jarrod Bowen is going off and Julen Lopetegui gives the last tactical orders to Crysencio Summerville (West Ham).
73' Substitution. Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) in, Michail Antonio out.
73' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) swings in a cross from the corner, but Alphonse Areola reads it well and gathers the ball.
71' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.
71' The ratio of the ball possession is 52:48.
69' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

67' What a huge chance for Jhon Duran (Aston Villa). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
66' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is penalised for a foul. Tony Harrington had a clear view and blows his whistle.
64' Lovely cross from Vladimir Coufal to find Michail Antonio (West Ham) deep in the box, but he steers his header well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
62' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) replaces Ollie Watkins.
62' Substitution. John McGinn makes his way off the pitch and Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) comes on as his replacement.

61' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
60' Aston Villa are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
57' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

57' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the right side of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Alphonse Areola. The referee points to the corner flag and Aston Villa will take a corner.

56' Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
55' West Ham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
55' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mohammed Kudus (West Ham). The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to West Ham.
52' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
50' Dangerous play by Vladimir Coufal (West Ham). Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.

49' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
49' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
47' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The ball possession is 47:53.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
45' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
44' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
42' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner but it's cleared.

41' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Emerson (West Ham) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Emiliano Martinez was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
37' 1 - 1 Goal! Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Emiliano Martinez to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
37' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
36' Referee Tony Harrington is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to West Ham!
36' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to West Ham, he's going to review using VAR.
36' The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. West Ham are awarded a penalty.
34' A raking crossfield pass from John McGinn (Aston Villa) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
32' John McGinn (Aston Villa) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
32' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
31' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) for his blatant foul.
30' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

30' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for West Ham.
29' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
27' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:5.

23' Off the post! Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range bounced off the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
21' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
21' A cross from John McGinn (Aston Villa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
19' A pass by Matty Cash (Aston Villa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
17' This shall not pass! Michail Antonio (West Ham) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
17' John McGinn (Aston Villa) makes a rough challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
16' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa), but Alphonse Areola is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
15' Good clearance! Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
13' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
11' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Alphonse Areola earns his money with a fine reflex save.
9' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Emerson (West Ham) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
9' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tony Harrington blows for a foul. West Ham have been awarded a free kick.
8' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tony Harrington had an easy-decision to make.
4' 0 - 1 Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
4' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and West Ham will have the kick-off.
Tony Harrington was nominated as the referee for this game.
